name: Driving licence renewal
description: Renew a driving licence with the Licensing Authority. An application is entertained up to one month before expiry; if more than five years late, the formalities for a fresh licence apply.
description_hi: लाइसेंसिंग प्राधिकरण से ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस का नवीनीकरण कराएँ। आवेदन समाप्ति से अधिकतम एक महीने पहले स्वीकार होता है; पाँच वर्ष से अधिक देर होने पर नए लाइसेंस की औपचारिकताएँ लागू होती हैं।
authority: State Transport Department / Licensing Authority (Parivahan Sewa, MoRTH)
verification_notes: From the Parivahan Sewa renewal page (central guidance; State Transport Departments administer licences and may differ). Fees are not modelled. Form 1 applies to non-transport vehicles and Form 1A to transport vehicles, so both are conditional. An expired licence can still be renewed; GovPath cannot express 'an expired copy is acceptable here', so tick the licence as available for this service.
